So also when the society hath placed the legislative in any assembly of men, to continue in them
and their successors, with direction and authority for providing such successors, the
legislative can never revert to the people whilst that government lasts.
Because having provided a legislative with power to continue forever, they have given
up their political power to the legislative, and cannot resume it.
